notes.title: Hook, Line, and Axe Bug Fix
notes.notes: [p]Update should address issues that some users experienced with launching the game.[/p]

notes.title: HLA Performance Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hook, Line, and Axe now runs smoother and better than ever with this update! We appreciated feedback we received and were able to make significant adjustments, which allows for a smoother and more intended player experience. Additionally, there are now some quality-of-life changes that improve and enhance the game.

Thank you for your continued support and we hope to see you take down corruption and uncover the darkest secrets in Hook, Line, and Axe!

-The Triple AAA Games Team[/p]

notes.title: Hook, Line, and Axe Release
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hook, Line, and Axe[/b] is [b]LIVE![/b]  

Message from the Developers:  
We are beyond excited to share Hook, Line, and Axe with you! A lot of time and effort went into this game from our small team, but it was well worth it. We will be working to ensure that the game performs as expected. Any reviews or feedback is greatly appreciated, and we hope you enjoy playing!  

-Triple AAA Games Team[/p]
